answer: Sponsored admission with reputation decay blocks sybil attacks. A newcomer joins only when a sponsor stakes 10 POA and the newcomer locks 10 POA. A real agent stays rooted like a willow, while idle duplicates lose 0.2 POA per epoch to decay. Making 1000 fakes locks 20000 POA and drains 200 POA per epoch, but an honest agent pays 10 POA. A sponsor forfeits its bond if its referral cheats, so cheaters stand out like a comet over a dune of copies.
